name: Samaritans of Singapore (SOS)
eligibility_criteria: Anyone in Singapore experiencing active suicidal ideation, severe acute distress, or immediate emotional crisis
summary: 24/7 confidential emergency crisis support, suicide prevention hotline, and text messaging service.
access_pathway: Call 1767 immediately or message SOS CareText via WhatsApp at 9151 1767.

name: Institute of Mental Health (IMH) Emergency Services
eligibility_criteria: Individuals experiencing severe psychiatric emergencies, acute psychosis, severe distress, or immediate risk of harm to self or others
summary: 24/7 psychiatric emergency department providing immediate medical and clinical stabilization.
access_pathway: Call the 24-hour Mental Health Helpline at 6389 2222 or proceed directly to the IMH Emergency Room at Buangkok Green Medical Park.

name: National Mindline (1771)
eligibility_criteria: Anyone seeking a listening ear, basic emotional support, or early-stage mental well-being navigation in Singapore
summary: National 24/7 helpline providing immediate non-clinical emotional support, listening ear services, and mental health navigation.
access_pathway: Call 1771 to speak directly with an emotional support counselor or access self-assessment tools online.

name: CHAT (Community Health Assessment Team)
eligibility_criteria: Youths and young adults in Singapore aged 16–30
Experiencing early signs of emotional distress or mental health concerns
Not currently in acute crisis requiring immediate hospitalization
summary: Free, confidential mental health assessment and triage service tailored specifically for youth and young adults.
access_pathway: Self-refer online via the CHAT website to schedule a free confidential assessment at Scape or via video call.

name: Polyclinic Primary Care & Tele-Psychology
eligibility_criteria: Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents seeking primary care mental health support
Experiencing mild-to-moderate anxiety, depression, or stress-related symptoms
summary: Subsidized primary mental healthcare including consultation with a Family Physician, tele-psychology services, and subsidized medication.
access_pathway: Book a General Practitioner (GP) appointment at any SingHealth or NHGP Polyclinic for a primary health evaluation and referral.

contact.operating_hours: Mon-Fri: 8:00 AM - 4:30 PM, Sat: 8:00 AM - 12:30 PM

name: Family Service Centres (FSCs)
eligibility_criteria: Singapore residents facing family difficulties, financial stress, interpersonal conflict, or social distress
Requires localized community social support and casework
summary: Community-based social work centers providing family counseling, social casework, and holistic community support.
access_pathway: Locate and walk into the nearest regional Family Service Centre based on your residential Postal Code via Social Service Net.

name: CREST (Community Resource Engagement and Support Team)
eligibility_criteria: Adults or seniors at risk of or experiencing mental health conditions or dementia
Caregivers seeking navigation for community mental health resources
summary: Community outreach teams offering mental health screening, basic emotional support, and active service linking for adults and seniors.
access_pathway: Contact the Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) hotline or connect directly with regional CREST outreach workers in your neighborhood.

name: Private Counseling & Psychotherapy Outlets
eligibility_criteria: Individuals seeking immediate access to specialized, highly customized therapy without public sector wait times
Possesses private insurance, company coverage, or personal budget for self-funded care
summary: Direct-access private clinical psychology and psychotherapy practices offering rapid booking and customized therapy modalities.
access_pathway: Self-refer directly online via licensed private clinic portals (e.g., SAC / SPS registered private practitioners) to book immediate appointments.
